scoring.notes: Compact suite: overlapping accepted-risk, destructive-risk, public-API normalization, diagnostic-restraint, selective failure-pattern, duplicate requirements-readiness, and prompt-injected orchestration cases were removed or folded into retained pressure cases. Representative cases keep full-artifact integration coverage; narrow policy cases are response-only so unrelated repository, artifact, and review execution does not dominate their measurement. This preserves the targeted per-case dimensions while accepting that narrow cases do not duplicate full-artifact pressure. Raw pass rates from earlier assertion or delivery-mode sets are not directly comparable. E32-E33 add report-derived plan pressure without claiming measured improvement; E34 separates requested plan creation from tracking, checkpoint, and sidecar authority.
